responsibility: Specifies the ISO character-classification API for CHAR values, declaring predicates for numeric, alphabetic, upper/lower case, control, and whitespace classification. It is a small utility interface consumed by scanners and conversion modules that need stable lexical character tests independent of device or parsing code.
same_name_distinction: This file is the public specification of the CharClass predicates, declaring the character tests only; the same-stem CharClass.mod provides the actual ASCII-based predicate bodies.
